VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 7, 2026
  3820 CHERRY AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90807
  EAST ROOM, 5:00 PM

Kenneth Osborn, Chair  Hershell Hardimon, Commissioner
Antawnette Atkins Blade, Vice Chair  Nicholas Sramek, Commissioner
Jerry Earl, Commissioner  Carlos Tec, Commissioner
James Goodin, Commissioner  Chad Vargas, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

 Members of the public have the option to email public comments to Veterans@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56389  Recommendation to discuss the City Council’s adoption of the Fiscal Year (FY)
  2027 Budget as it relates to the jurisdiction of the Veterans Affairs Commission,
  including the budget allocation for the Public Health Professional III position in the
  Office of Veterans Support, and, if appropriate, create an ad hoc committee to draft
  a letter to Mayor and City Council on the FY 2027 Budget’s impacts on the Veteran
  Affairs Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56390  Recommendation to receive and file a report on the 2026 Long Beach Veterans
  Day Celebration.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Veterans Affairs Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Karen Baldwin, Senior City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24
hours prior to the meeting.

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:26 PM, Commissioner Tec called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Tec, Vargas, Osborn

Commissioners Absent: Earl, Atkins Blade

Also present: Gina Overholt, Coordinator, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist.

Vice Chair Atkins Blade and Commissioner Earl were excused from the meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Sramek led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56389  Recommendation to discuss the City Council’s adoption of the Fiscal Year (FY)
  2027 Budget as it relates to the jurisdiction of the Veterans Affairs Commission,
  including the budget allocation for the Public Health Professional III position in the
  Office of Veterans Support, and, if appropriate, create an ad hoc committee to draft
  a letter to Mayor and City Council on the FY 2027 Budget’s impacts on the Veteran
  Affairs Commission.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Sramek, seconded by Commissioner
  Vargas, to approve recommendation, as amended, to create the 2027 Budget
  Ad Hoc Committee consisting of Chair Osborn, Commissioner Goodin, and
  Commissioner Tec, which will dissolve upon completion of the letter. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6 Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Tec, Vargas, Osborn
